title: Seeded matrix product verification result
statement: Let $n,r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $s:\{0,1\}^r\to\mathbb{F}_2^n$ be a seed map. For a seed $b\in\{0,1\}^r$, define the result to be the Boolean outcome of the matrix product verification decision on $A,B,C'$ and $s(b)$.
hypotheses_covered: Seed map from $r$ Boolean bits to $\mathbb{F}_2^n$
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the matrix product verification decision, so its precise acceptance criterion cannot be stated from this payload alone.
